A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show how to use the beamforming gain to reduce the number of hops for the message transmission.
for a fixed number of nodes in a fixed area, the energy consumption is independent of the number of nodes and the time needed to transmit a message from any source to any target is logarithmic.

The main takeaway from our work is that
beamforming can be used to achieve a constant factor speedup in time compared to optimal multi-hop routing strategies.
the beamforming gain can be exploited to achieve the same asymptotical performance as the best multi-hop routing strategy, even when the carrier phase is not synchronized.
beamforming is a promising technique for wireless communication in ad-hoc networks.
